keyVerseDR: "A wise man shall hear, and shall be wiser." (Prv 1:5)

level1.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Love of Learning
level1.story: Love of learning means wanting to learn new skills and new things. Every day God gives us a chance to grow!
level1.keyLine: I love to learn and grow.
level1.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice love of learning all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What new thing did each of us learn this week?
What would we like to learn together next?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
Practice love of learning every day
level1.prayer: Lord, thank You for my mind. Help me learn with joy and grow wiser each day. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Learn a new word and use it today
TUE: Practice reading for ten minutes
WED: Learn one line of a new prayer
THU: Ask someone to teach you a skill
FRI: Learn a fact about a saint
SAT: Show your family something you learned

level2.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Love of Learning
level2.story: Love of learning is the joy of growing in skills and knowledge. It means practicing until we master something new, reading, asking, and trying again. God gave us minds to know Him and His world. Saints like Thomas Aquinas loved to learn so they could love God more. Learning is not just for school; it is a lifelong adventure with Jesus.
level2.keyLine: I love to learn and grow.
level2.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice love of learning all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What new thing did each of us learn this week?
How did God help us grow in love of learning?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
Practice love of learning every day
level2.prayer: Lord, thank You for my mind. Help me learn with joy and grow wiser each day. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Set one learning goal for the week
TUE: Practice a hard skill for 15 minutes
WED: Memorize a short Bible verse
THU: Teach a younger child something you know
FRI: Read a chapter of a good book
SAT: Learn more about one part of the Mass
